text: Ten fictional nonprofit programme passages, each with two changed-quantity, two reordered and two moved-negation quote variants for citation-checker testing.

passages.source_passage: Welcome to the volunteer orientation for the Kestrel Valley Access Project. During your first week, you will shadow an experienced fitter for at least 3 home visits before working alone. Each visit should take about ninety minutes, including the accessibility checklist. Always ask the participant before touching a wheelchair, walking frame or hearing aid. In 2023, 42% of follow-up complaints concerned cushions that had been fitted too quickly. Measure the seat width before the backrest height, and record both in the green logbook, not on loose paper. If a ramp is steeper than the guidance allows, do not attempt a temporary fix; report it to the site engineer rather than the participant's family.

variants.changed_quantity_2: Each visit should take about sixty minutes, including the accessibility checklist.
variants.reordered: Measure the backrest height before the seat width, and record both in the green logbook
variants.reordered_2: do not attempt a temporary fix; report it to the participant's family rather than the site engineer.
variants.moved_negation: If a ramp is not steeper than the guidance allows, do attempt a temporary fix
variants.moved_negation_2: and record both not in the green logbook, on loose paper.

passages.source_passage: This module prepares volunteers supporting caseworkers in Zones B and D of Marrow Plains Camp. Each caseworker currently holds around 60 open files, so volunteers handle intake screening only. Always complete the safety questions before the household questions, because urgent risks can surface early. Children under 18 who arrive without a caregiver are referred within 24 hours to the child protection focal point, not the general helpdesk. Volunteers do not promise resettlement outcomes, and a family that is not registered should still receive the information leaflet. Since March 2024, interviews have been held in the women's centre, which roughly 70% of female clients said felt safer. Never leave a completed form on the desk; lock it in the cabinet before the next interview.

passages.source_passage: The mid-term evaluation of the Ollerby Farmer Field School Network covered 36 schools across four sub-counties between January and June 2024. Participating farmers adopted mulching faster than intercropping, largely because mulch materials were already available on most plots. Average maize yields rose by 18% among members, compared with 6% in neighbouring non-member households. However, the evaluation did not find evidence that women facilitators were trained less often than men; attendance records were incomplete in several schools. Seed fairs were not held in the second season because the district depot closed early. Facilitators reported that demonstration plots, not take-home leaflets, were the main source of new practices. The team recommends strengthening record-keeping before expanding to new sites.

passages.source_passage: At the midpoint of the Lusenge District Community Health Programme, 214 community health workers were active in 31 villages, against a target of 250. Household visits per worker averaged nine per week, below the planned twelve. Workers in upland villages travelled further than workers in lakeside villages, yet reported higher visit completion. Stock-outs of malaria test kits were not reported in the first year but were in the second. Supervisors confirmed that referral slips, not verbal referrals, were used in most cases. The evaluation team could not verify stipend payments for the third quarter of 2023 because ledgers were unavailable. Workers who received bicycles did not leave, while workers who received none often did.

passages.source_passage: Thanks to the continued support of the Harrowgate Foundation, the Brightmoor Vocational Training Centre enrolled 148 young people in 2024, up from 112 the previous year. Welding and tailoring remained the most popular courses, with electrical installation close behind. Within six months of graduating, 61% of trainees were in paid work or self-employment. Employers hired our graduates before graduates from the municipal college in three of four recruitment rounds. We did not reach our target for young women in construction trades. The evening cohort was not launched, but the weekend cohort was. The centre never charges tuition, though trainees contribute toward safety equipment. Next year we will add a solar maintenance course in partnership with local installers.

passages.source_passage: Volunteer cooks at the Sabouni Primary School Meals Programme serve lunch to roughly 450 pupils each school day. Wash your hands before handling the rice and after handling raw fish, and wear a hairnet at all times. Portions are measured with the blue ladle: two scoops for younger pupils and three for Class 5 and 6. Salt is added during cooking and not at the table, following the menu agreed with the district nutrition officer in 2022. Pupils with fish allergies are not served fish, but they are served beans. Report any pupil who has not eaten for two days to the head teacher, not the parent committee. No food may leave the kitchen in personal containers.

passages.source_passage: Monitoring visits in the Tamsin Ridge Resilient Crops Project took place in September 2024 across 54 demonstration plots. Rainfall in the season was 23% below the ten-year average. Sorghum outperformed cowpea on sandy soils, while cowpea did better on clay plots near the seasonal river. Farmers who planted after the first rains did not lose seedlings, but those who planted before did. Seed of the improved millet variety did not reach the eastern cluster until late July, so those plots were excluded from yield estimates. Water harvesting pits were dug on 31 plots but were never lined on 12 of them. Field staff noted that farmers adopted early planting before they adopted pit maintenance.

variants.moved_negation_2: Farmers who planted after the first rains did lose seedlings, but those who planted before did not.

passages.source_passage: Board members will be pleased to hear that the Willowmere Playgroup Network now runs 19 playgroups, three more than at the last meeting. Average weekly attendance reached 260 children aged two to five. Parents have asked for more outdoor sessions than indoor sessions, and facilitators are adjusting timetables accordingly. The toy library has not been relaunched, but the book exchange has. We did not renew the lease on the Carver Street hall, as the landlord raised rent by 40%. Facilitator training will follow the parent workshops in April 2025, not precede them. Two families withdrew not because of fees but because of transport. The coordinator wishes to note that no safeguarding incidents were reported this quarter.

passages.source_passage: The mid-term evaluation of the Karnapur Mother and Newborn Outreach Project reviewed records from 12 health posts and 38 outreach camps held since April 2023. Antenatal attendance of four or more visits rose from 41% to 57% of registered pregnancies. Outreach nurses visited remote hamlets before market towns in each cycle, which evaluators judged appropriate. Postnatal home visits within 48 hours were not achieved for most caesarean births, which were followed up at the clinic rather than at home. Kangaroo care was not practised in the night shift, but it was practised during the day. Community volunteers in two blocks had been trained on danger signs but not on cord care. The evaluators did not recommend scaling up until the referral transport gap is closed.

passages.source_passage: This update summarises the Fernhollow Paralegal Outreach Service for the quarter ending 30 June 2024. Our seven paralegals held 85 community clinics and opened 312 new cases, most involving land disputes and unpaid wages. Tenants approached us more often than landlords, reversing last year's pattern. We did not take on criminal defence matters, which remain outside our mandate, and referred them to the bar association rather than the magistrate's office. Two paralegals resigned in May; their posts have not been filled, but interviews are scheduled. Clients who received written advice did not return with the same problem, while those who received only verbal advice often did. Funding for the mobile clinic is secured until December, not beyond.
